name: Sumtics – AI Summarizer & TL;DR Generator
author: Apselo

sections.description:
Sumtics is the AI summarizer for WordPress that turns long posts into clear, skimmable TL;DR summaries – automatically. It generates a real AI summary for every article using your WordPress AI connector, and adds one-click buttons that let readers summarize your content with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Google AI, or Perplexity.

Long articles lose readers. Sumtics gives visitors the gist in seconds, boosts time-on-page and engagement, and helps your content stay readable in an AI-first world – including AI Overviews and answer engines that reward clear, summarizable content.

Sumtics homepage · Read the documentation · Get support

Why Sumtics?

  • Real AI summaries, generated for you – not just a link out. Sumtics writes an actual TL;DR for each post.
  • Uses your WordPress AI connector – works natively with the WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0+) and providers like Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini) and OpenAI (ChatGPT). Configure once in Settings → Connectors.
  • Zero-cost fallback – a built-in on-server summary engine works even without any AI provider, so you always get a summary.
  • No code required – set it up in minutes with a clean, modern settings panel.

Three ways to summarize

1. Inline AI Summary (TL;DR box)
Automatically generate a concise TL;DR for each post when it is published or updated, then display it inline above or below your content in a clean, collapsible box. Powered by the built-in WordPress AI connector, with an on-server extractive fallback. Set the length (1–5 sentences), choose your model, or let Sumtics pick a sensible default automatically.

2. External AI Summarize Buttons
Add one-click buttons that open the reader’s favorite AI assistant – ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Google AI or Perplexity – pre-filled with a smart summarize prompt for your article. Great for engagement and AI-driven discovery.

3. Floating AI Button (FAB)
A floating “Summarize” button that follows the reader and expands to the AI tools you enable. Position it anywhere on screen.

Key Features

  • Automatic TL;DR generation – AI summaries created on publish/update, cached for fast loading
  • WordPress AI connector support – native WP AI Client integration (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT)
  • On-server extractive summarizer – free, private fallback that never calls an external API
  • Inline summary box – collapsible, theme-adaptive, transparent design that blends with any theme
  • One-click AI summarize buttons – ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Google AI, Perplexity
  • Floating action button (FAB) – six positions with custom offsets
  • Per-post controls – edit, regenerate or override the summary for any post in the editor
  • Bulk backfill – generate summaries for all existing posts in one click
  • Content-type targeting – choose exactly which post types get summaries and buttons
  • Custom prompts & lengths – global defaults with per-post overrides
  • Shortcodes – drop summaries and buttons anywhere with [sumtics_ai_summarize] and [sumtics_floating_button]
  • Modern settings UI – organized, fast and beginner-friendly
  • Translation-ready & lightweight – built for performance and SEO

Supported AI Models

  • ChatGPT (OpenAI)
  • Claude (Anthropic)
  • Gemini (Google)
  • Grok (xAI)
  • Perplexity
  • Google AI Mode

Perfect For

Blogs, news and magazine sites, documentation, knowledge bases, online courses and any content-heavy website where readers want a fast TL;DR – and where you want your content optimized for SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization) and GEO (generative engine optimization).

Privacy & Cost

The inline AI summary uses the AI provider you connect in WordPress (Settings → Connectors); summary generation happens through that provider. The on-server extractive engine runs entirely on your site and never sends content to a third party. The external summarize buttons simply open the reader’s chosen AI tool in a new tab – no API key required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sumtics folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install Sumtics directly from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. (For AI summaries) On WordPress 7.0+, connect an AI provider under Settings → Connectors (Anthropic, Google or OpenAI).
  4. Go to Sumtics → Settings to enable the inline summary, choose your engine/model, and configure the summarize buttons and floating button.
  5. Open Sumtics → Settings → Inline Summary → Generate for all existing posts to backfill summaries for older content.
sections.faq:
What does Sumtics do?

Sumtics is an AI summarizer for WordPress. It automatically generates a TL;DR summary for each post and displays it inline, and it adds one-click buttons so readers can summarize your content with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Google AI or Perplexity.

How are the AI summaries generated?

Inline summaries are generated through the built-in WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0+) using the provider you connect under Settings → Connectors – such as Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini) or OpenAI (ChatGPT). If AI is unavailable, Sumtics can fall back to a built-in on-server summarizer.

Do I need an API key?

For the inline AI summary you connect a provider once in Settings → Connectors. For the external summarize buttons you do not need any API key – they open the reader’s chosen AI tool with a ready-made prompt. The on-server (basic) summary engine needs no key at all.

Does Sumtics work without an AI provider?

Yes. Choose the “Basic” engine (or enable the fallback) and Sumtics will build summaries on your server with no external API calls – free and private.

When are summaries created?

Automatically when a post is published or updated. They are cached in the post so the front end loads fast. You can also click “Regenerate now” in the editor, or bulk-generate summaries for all existing posts from the settings page.

Can I choose which post types get summaries?

Yes. You can target posts, pages and any custom post type for both the inline summary and the summarize buttons.

Can I edit a summary manually?

Yes. Open the post editor, edit the summary in the Sumtics box, and your version is kept – automatic regeneration will not overwrite manual edits.

Will the summary box match my theme?

Yes. The inline TL;DR box uses a transparent, theme-adaptive design, so it inherits your theme’s colors and looks good in light and dark themes.

Does Sumtics help with SEO, AEO and GEO?

Clear, structured summaries make content easier to scan for readers and easier to understand for search engines, AI Overviews and answer/generative engines. Better skimmability typically improves engagement signals too.

Which AI models are supported?

ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Grok (xAI), Perplexity and Google AI Mode.

Can I add summaries with a shortcode?

Yes. Use [sumtics_ai_summarize] for inline buttons and [sumtics_floating_button] for the floating button. See Sumtics → Shortcodes & Help for all attributes.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: Inline AI Summary – automatically generate a real TL;DR for every post using the built-in WordPress AI connector (WP AI Client, WordPress 7.0+) with Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT providers.
  • New: On-server extractive summary engine – a zero-cost, private fallback that works without any AI provider.
  • New: Simple generation controls – enable inline summaries, pick the AI or Basic engine, and optionally fall back to a basic summary if AI is unavailable.
  • New: Per-post summary controls in the editor – view, edit and “Regenerate now”.
  • New: Bulk “Generate for all existing posts” tool to backfill older content.
  • New: Theme-adaptive inline TL;DR box (transparent background, inherits theme colors, collapsible).
  • New: Completely redesigned settings interface – modern sidebar + cards with toggle switches.
  • New: Settings reorganized into General, Inline Summary, External Summary, Floating Button, Prompts and Styling.
  • New: “Shortcodes & Help” page with documentation, support links and related plugins.
  • Improvement: Faster front-end output and clearer model selection.

1.0.2

  • Tweak: Prompt optimization and caching for faster loading.

1.0.1

  • New: Google AI support added.
  • New: No-follow attribute option for button links.
  • New: WordPress 6.9 compatibility.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
